# Problem 1
<!-- #endregion -->

<!-- #region id="cF8wzmc7whx2" -->
Train a neural network classifier to predict counterfeit banknotes. Use the features `a0` and `a3`. Calculate the confussion matrix  and AUC score.
<!-- #endregion -->

```{python id="kRNMTNpfwe1A"}
import torch
import torch.nn as tnn
```

```{python id="QyqYJeMdwjqO"}
features= [0, 3]
nf=len(features)
```

```{python id="3AGZYUKMwkts"}
features_train = torch.from_numpy(data_train.values[:,features]).to(dtype=torch.float32)
labels_train = torch.from_numpy(data_train.values[:,4:5]).to(dtype=torch.float32)
```

```{python id="vbGV3-DNwl5_"}
features_test = torch.from_numpy(data_test.values[:,features]).to(dtype=torch.float32)
labels_test = torch.from_numpy(data_test.values[:,4:5]).to(dtype=torch.float32)
```

```{python id="xAEjI_vAwnVS"}
model = tnn.Sequential(tnn.Linear(in_features=nf, out_features=1), tnn.Sigmoid())
```

```{python id="MSJ594sowopq"}
from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, confusion_matrix, accuracy_score
```

```{python id="vrnHJbyGwpvy"}
y_true = labels_test.numpy()
with torch.no_grad():
  y_proba = model(features_test);
  y_predicted = 1*(y_proba>0.5)
```

```{python colab={'base_uri': 'https://localhost:8080/'}, id="WuLGJ5C8wqew", outputId="61cf0e6a-7cae-4733-f90c-ca8b46343a80"}
accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred=y_predicted)
```

**Model 1**
<!-- #endregion -->

```{python id="2-1Cygndy72M"}
class NeuralNetwork(tnn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size):
        super(NeuralNetwork, self).__init__()
        self.layer1 = tnn.Linear(input_size, 16) # First hidden layer
        self.relu1 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.layer2 = tnn.Linear(16, 8) # Second hidden layer
        self.relu2 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.output_layer = tnn.Linear(8, 1) # Output layer
        self.sigmoid = tnn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.layer1(x)
        x = self.relu1(x)
        x = self.layer2(x)
        x = self.relu2(x)
        x = self.output_layer(x)
        x = self.sigmoid(x)
        return x

model = NeuralNetwork(nf)
loss_fn = tnn.BCELoss()
```

```{python id="a10bf624"}
optimizer = torch.optim.SGD(model.parameters(),lr=0.001)
```

```{python colab={'base_uri': 'https://localhost:8080/'}, id="qDNbdcuswsWn", outputId="1e4fc629-db3d-4cf7-c904-8c6000a20402"}
for era in range(50):
    for epoch in range(500):
        optimizer.zero_grad()
        pred = model(features_train)
        loss = loss_fn(pred, labels_train)
        loss.backward()
        optimizer.step()
    with torch.no_grad():
        pred =  model(features_train)
        acc_train =  torch.mean(0.0+ ((pred > 0.5)== (labels_train>0.5)))
        pred =  model(features_test)
        acc_test =  torch.mean(0.0+ ((pred > 0.5)== (labels_test>0.5)))
    print(acc_train, acc_test)
```

```{python id="6e77e298"}
class NeuralNetworkV2(tnn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size):
        super(NeuralNetworkV2, self).__init__()
        self.layer1 = tnn.Linear(input_size, 32) # First hidden layer
        self.relu1 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.layer2 = tnn.Linear(32, 16) # Second hidden layer
        self.relu2 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.layer3 = tnn.Linear(16, 8) # Third hidden layer
        self.relu3 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.output_layer = tnn.Linear(8, 1) # Output layer
        self.sigmoid = tnn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.layer1(x)
        x = self.relu1(x)
        x = self.layer2(x)
        x = self.relu2(x)
        x = self.layer3(x)
        x = self.relu3(x)
        x = self.output_layer(x)
        x = self.sigmoid(x)
        return x

model_v2 = NeuralNetworkV2(nf)
loss_fn_v2 = tnn.BCELoss()
```


```{python id="a414bfbb"}
class NeuralNetworkV3(tnn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size):
        super(NeuralNetworkV3, self).__init__()
        self.fc1 = tnn.Linear(input_size, 64)
        self.bn1 = tnn.BatchNorm1d(64)
        self.relu1 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.dropout1 = tnn.Dropout(0.3)

        self.fc2 = tnn.Linear(64, 32)
        self.bn2 = tnn.BatchNorm1d(32)
        self.relu2 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.dropout2 = tnn.Dropout(0.3)

        self.fc3 = tnn.Linear(32, 16)
        self.bn3 = tnn.BatchNorm1d(16)
        self.relu3 = tnn.ReLU()

        self.output_layer = tnn.Linear(16, 1)
        self.sigmoid = tnn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.bn1(x)
        x = self.relu1(x)
        x = self.dropout1(x)

        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.bn2(x)
        x = self.relu2(x)
        x = self.dropout2(x)

        x = self.fc3(x)
        x = self.bn3(x)
        x = self.relu3(x)

        x = self.output_layer(x)
        x = self.sigmoid(x)
        return x

model_v3 = NeuralNetworkV3(nf)
loss_fn_v3 = tnn.BCELoss()
```

```{python id="be9627c4"}
import torch.optim as optim
optimizer_v3 = optim.Adam(model_v3.parameters(), lr=0.001)
```

```{python id="d0da19d9"}
class NeuralNetworkV4(tnn.Module):
    def __init__(self, input_size):
        super(NeuralNetworkV4, self).__init__()
        self.fc1 = tnn.Linear(input_size, 128)
        self.bn1 = tnn.BatchNorm1d(128)
        self.relu1 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.dropout1 = tnn.Dropout(0.4)

        self.fc2 = tnn.Linear(128, 64)
        self.bn2 = tnn.BatchNorm1d(64)
        self.relu2 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.dropout2 = tnn.Dropout(0.4)

        self.fc3 = tnn.Linear(64, 32)
        self.bn3 = tnn.BatchNorm1d(32)
        self.relu3 = tnn.ReLU()
        self.dropout3 = tnn.Dropout(0.3)

        self.fc4 = tnn.Linear(32, 16)
        self.bn4 = tnn.BatchNorm1d(16)
        self.relu4 = tnn.ReLU()

        self.output_layer = tnn.Linear(16, 1)
        self.sigmoid = tnn.Sigmoid()

    def forward(self, x):
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.bn1(x)
        x = self.relu1(x)
        x = self.dropout1(x)

        x = self.fc2(x)
        x = self.bn2(x)
        x = self.relu2(x)
        x = self.dropout2(x)

        x = self.fc3(x)
        x = self.bn3(x)
        x = self.relu3(x)
        x = self.dropout3(x)

        x = self.fc4(x)
        x = self.bn4(x)
        x = self.relu4(x)

        x = self.output_layer(x)
        x = self.sigmoid(x)
        return x

model_v4 = NeuralNetworkV4(nf)
loss_fn_v4 = tnn.BCELoss()
```

